0003.note: Check errors name what was found more clearly ("the string \"dark\"" rather than "tag dark"); conformance compares them up to "Got" (languages/l0003/CLAUDE.md, "Conformance").
The TypeScript L0003 is on @graffiticode/l0000 0.8; the Rust kernel also has exact numbers and format-number, and serves those words (languages/l0003/CLAUDE.md, "Conformance").

The Rust kernel unwraps the {data, errors} envelope an upstream stage delivers, so the posted state is laid over the result at the top level, as languages/l0003/CLAUDE.md says ("Upstream data wins"). TypeScript spreads the raw envelope, adding `data` and `errors` keys instead. Affects every L0003 compile over data, View recompiles included (owner's decision 2026-10-30, as for L0174).
